title: deploymentWorktree
responsibility: Runs deployment work in an isolated checkout of an immutable commit and removes that checkout afterward.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.root
inputs.description: Repository directory passed to every git call as `git -C <root>`; the commit is resolved there and the temporary worktree is added and removed there. The implementation does not check that it is absolute or that it is a repository, and a path git cannot run in makes the first git call reject.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.commit
inputs.description: Revision that git resolves to a full commit SHA with `git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <commit>^{commit}` before the checkout, so a branch or tag is pinned to the commit it names when the call starts. An empty value, a value longer than 300 characters, or a value containing a NUL character is rejected with 'Invalid revision.' before any git command runs.

inputs.name: deploymentWorktree.work
inputs.description: Async callback that the implementation calls once, after `git worktree add` succeeds, with the path of a `source` directory inside a new `harness-deployment-` directory under `os.tmpdir()`. Its resolved value is returned and its rejection is re-thrown, and the checkout is force-removed when its promise settles.

outputs.name: deploymentWorktree
outputs.description: Resolved value of `work`, returned only after the checkout is force-removed and its temporary directory is deleted; if `work` rejects or any git or file-system step fails, the call rejects with that error instead.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by gitRevision with the message 'Invalid revision.' when the commit is empty, longer than 300 characters, or contains a NUL character; no git command runs and no temporary directory is created.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the error from gitRead when `git -C <root> rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <commit>^{commit}` fails (cannot start, non-zero exit such as an unresolvable commit, killed by a signal, or stdout over gitRead's 64000000-byte maxBuffer); no temporary directory is created.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the error from gitRead when `git -C <root> worktree add --detach <directory> <resolved SHA>` fails (cannot start, non-zero exit, killed by a signal, or stdout over gitRead's 64000000-byte maxBuffer); the callback is not called and the temporary directory is still deleted.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the error from gitRead when `git -C <root> worktree remove --force <directory>` fails during cleanup after the callback settles (cannot start, non-zero exit, killed by a signal, or stdout over gitRead's 64000000-byte maxBuffer); it replaces the callback's result or error, and the temporary directory is not deleted because the following rm is skipped.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the file-system error from mkdtemp when no harness-deployment- directory can be created under os.tmpdir(); no worktree is added.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the file-system error from rm, called with recursive and force set, when the temporary directory cannot be deleted during cleanup; it replaces the callback's result or error.

errors.name: callback error
errors.description: Whatever value work throws or rejects with is re-thrown unchanged once the cleanup succeeds, so its type depends on the callback.
